function.name: edit_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "config.txt", "content": "# /boot/firmware/config.txt
enable_uart=1
# 1-wire bus on GPIO17 (the overlay defaults to GPIO4; pin must match the wiring).
dtoverlay=w1-gpio,gpiopin=17
"}

text: Fixed: the 1-wire overlay defaults to GPIO4, but the DS18B20 data line is on GPIO17. Set the pin explicitly with dtoverlay=w1-gpio,gpiopin=17 and reboot so the bus comes up on the wired pin.
